newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish firms show Jan-May PLN 4.8 bln net profit.
newsitem.headline: Polish firms show Jan-May PLN 4.8 bln net profit.

text.p: Polish enterprises reported an overall 4.8 billion zloty net profit in the January-May period, compared with a 4.2 billion zloty net profit in the same period of 1996, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.

GUS said the private sector had a net profit of 2.7 billion zlotys on total revenues of 138.3 billion zlotys in the period against a profit of two billion and sales of 95.5 billion in the same period last year.
The state-owned sector reported a profit of 2.0 billion on sales of 119.2 billion versus last year's 2.2 billion and 106.8 billion respectively.
NOTES: Data collected from all companies employing more than 50 people in main sectors of the economy.
Liquidity ratio is a percentage relation of cash reserves and tradable securities to short-term liabilities.
